type_display_name: The display name of the type that will be used in UIs, e.g., marketplace, in title case.
type_name: A label that defines the generalised category of an attribute, based on shared characteristics or function.
value_str: The string representation of the value, for display purpose.
last_modified_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the attribute was modified the last time in the metadata source.
ingestion_time: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the attribute was ingested into DKG.
type_id: The globally unique id of the attribute type, generated by DKG using uuidv5.
last_modified_by: The identifier of the user in the metadata source who modified the attribute the last time. If missing, the value of last_modified_by of the asset is used.
asset_id: The globally unique id of the asset which the attribute belongs to.
created_by: The identifier of the user in the metadata source who created the attribute. If missing, the value of created_by of the asset is used.
created_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the attribute was created in the metadata source.
data_type: The type of the attribute value, e.g., string, numeric, boolean, etc.
id: The globally unique id of the attribute generated by DKG using uuidv5.
